# Daily fresh-arena checks

*Auto-generated by `recheck.py`, last updated 2026-10-06T19:17:16.*

Every day each optimal brain is re-run in MuJoCo on a new set of random arenas it has never seen. The fixed held-out test decides 'optimal' (>= 90%); these checks watch for brains that only look good on that fixed set. Anything under 80% is flagged.
